attributes.title: Comment from OneSource Solutions International (OSSI)
attributes.comment: Please see the attached public comment of Harold Arkoff, MD and Vedran Jukic responding to FDA’s August 2026 discussion paper, “Considerations for the Regulation of Generative AI-Enabled Medical Devices: Discussion Paper and Request for Feedback,” Docket No. FDA-2026-N-7874. The attached comment addresses the discussion questions concerning risk assessment, competency-based premarket evaluation, postmarket monitoring, foundation models, and agentic AI.
